verses.text_en: Then Eleazar, an illustrious priest of the country, who had attained to length of days, and whose life had been adorned with virtue, caused the elders who were around him to cease to cry out to the holy God, and prayed this:
verses.text_hr: Tada je Eleazar, ugledni domaći svećenik koji je doživio duboku starost i svoj život ukrasio krepošću, pozvao starješine oko sebe da prestanu vapiti svetomu Bogu pa se ovako pomolio:

verses.text_en: “O king, mighty in power, most high, Almighty God, who regulates the whole creation with your tender mercy,
verses.text_hr: „Kralju silne moći, Svevišnji, svemogući Bože, koji svojim nježnim milosrđem upravljaš svim stvorenjem,

verses.text_en: look at the seed of Abraham, at the children of the sanctified Jacob, your sanctified inheritance, O Father, now being wrongfully destroyed as foreigners in a foreign land.
verses.text_hr: pogledaj Abrahamovo potomstvo, djecu posvećenoga Jakova, svoju posvećenu baštinu, Oče, koju sada nepravedno uništavaju kao tuđince u tuđoj zemlji.

verses.text_en: You destroyed Pharaoh with his army of chariots when that lord of this same Egypt was uplifted with lawless daring and loud-sounding tongue. Shedding the beams of your mercy upon the race of Israel, you overwhelmed him and his proud army.
verses.text_hr: Faraona si s njegovom vojskom bojnih kola uništio kad se taj vladar upravo ovoga Egipta uzoholio u bezakonoj drskosti i razmetljivu govoru. Svojim si milosrđem obasjao izraelski rod, a njega i njegovu oholu vojsku potopio.

verses.text_en: When Sennacherim, the grievous king of the Assyrians, exulting in his countless army, had subdued the whole land with his spear and was lifting himself against your holy city with boastings grievous to be endured, you, O Lord, demolished him and displayed your might to many nations.
verses.text_hr: Kad se Sanherib, okrutni kralj Asiraca, uzdao u svoju bezbrojnu vojsku, kopljem pokorio svu zemlju i uzdizao se protiv tvojega svetoga grada nepodnošljivim hvalisanjem, ti si ga, Gospodine, satro i svoju moć pokazao mnogim narodima.

verses.text_en: When the three friends in the land of Babylon of their own will exposed their lives to the fire rather than serve vain things, you sent a moist coolness through the fiery furnace, and brought the fire on all their adversaries.
verses.text_hr: Kad su tri prijatelja u zemlji Babilonu svojevoljno izložila živote ognju radije nego da služe ispraznim stvarima, ti si kroz užarenu peć poslao rosnu svježinu, a oganj okrenuo na sve njihove protivnike.

verses.text_en: It was you who, when Daniel was hurled, through slander and envy, as a prey to lions down below, brought him back again unharmed to light.
verses.text_hr: Ti si Daniela, kojega su zbog klevete i zavisti bacili u dubinu kao plijen lavovima, ponovno izveo neozlijeđena na svjetlo.

verses.text_en: When Jonah was pining away in the belly of the sea-born monster, you looked at him, O Father, and recovered him to the sight of his own.
verses.text_hr: Kad je Jona kopnio u utrobi morske nemani, pogledao si na njega, Oče, i vratio ga da ga njegovi ponovno ugledaju.

verses.text_en: Now, you who hate insolence, you who abound in mercy, you who are the protector of all things, appear quickly to those of the race of Israel, who are insulted by abhorred, lawless gentiles.
verses.text_hr: Sada ti, koji mrziš oholost, obiluješ milosrđem i štitiš sve, brzo se objavi pripadnicima izraelskoga roda koje vrijeđaju odvratni bezakoni pogani.

verses.text_en: If our life during our exile has been stained with iniquity, deliver us from the hand of the enemy, and destroy us, O Lord, by the death which you prefer.
verses.text_hr: Ako se naš život u izgnanstvu okaljao bezakonjem, izbavi nas iz ruke neprijatelja, a zatim nas ti, Gospodine, usmrti smrću koju sam izabereš.

verses.text_en: Don’t let the vain-minded congratulate vain idols at the destruction of your beloved, saying, ‘Their god didn’t deliver them.’
verses.text_hr: Ne dopusti da se isprazni umovi zbog propasti tvojih ljubljenih čestitaju ispraznim idolima i govore: ‘Njihov ih bog nije izbavio.’

verses.text_en: You who are All-powerful and Almighty, O Eternal One, behold! Have mercy on us who are being withdrawn from life, like traitors, by the unreasoning insolence of lawless men.
verses.text_hr: Ti koji si svesilan i svemoguć, Vječni, pogledaj nas! Smiluj se nama koje bezumna drskost bezakonika odvlači iz života kao izdajice.

verses.text_en: Let the heathen cower before your invincible might today, O glorious One, who have all power to save the race of Jacob.
verses.text_hr: Neka se pogani danas prestraše pred tvojom nepobjedivom silom, Slavni, koji imaš svu moć spasiti Jakovljev rod.

verses.text_en: The whole band of infants and their parents ask you with tears.
verses.text_hr: Čitavo mnoštvo dojenčadi i njihovih roditelja sa suzama te moli.

verses.text_en: Let it be shown to all the nations that you are with us, O Lord, and have not turned your face away from us, but as you said that you would not forget them even in the land of their enemies, so fulfill this saying, O Lord.”
verses.text_hr: Pokaži svim narodima da si s nama, Gospodine, i da nisi odvratio svoje lice od nas. Kao što si rekao da nas nećeš zaboraviti čak ni u zemlji naših neprijatelja, tako ispuni tu riječ, Gospodine.“

verses.text_en: Now, at the time that Eleazar had ended his prayer, the king came along to the hippodrome with the wild animals, and with his tumultuous power.
verses.text_hr: Kad je Eleazar završio molitvu, kralj je s divljim životinjama i svojom bučnom vojnom silom stigao do hipodroma.

verses.text_en: When the Jews saw this, they uttered a loud cry to heaven so that the adjacent valleys resounded and caused an irrepressible lamentation throughout the army.
verses.text_hr: Kad su to Židovi vidjeli, podigli su prema nebu tako glasan vapaj da su odjeknule obližnje doline, a cijelom se vojskom proširilo nezaustavljivo naricanje.

verses.text_en: Then the all-glorious, all-powerful, and true God, displayed his holy countenance, and opened the gates of heaven, from which two angels, dreadful of form, came down and were visible to all but the Jews.
verses.text_hr: Tada je sveslavni, svemoćni i istiniti Bog pokazao svoje sveto lice i otvorio nebeska vrata. Iz njih su sišla dva anđela strašna izgleda, vidljiva svima osim Židovima.

verses.text_en: They stood opposite, and filled the enemies’ army with confusion and cowardice, and bound them with immoveable shackles.
verses.text_hr: Stali su nasuprot neprijateljima, ispunili njihovu vojsku smetenošću i kukavičlukom te ih sputali nepomičnim okovima.

verses.text_en: A cold shudder came over the person of the king, and oblivion paralyzed the vehemence of his spirit.
verses.text_hr: Kraljevim je tijelom prostrujio hladan drhtaj, a zaborav je ukočio žestinu njegova duha.

verses.text_en: They turned back the animals on the armed forces who followed them; and the animals trampled them and destroyed them.
verses.text_hr: Anđeli su životinje okrenuli protiv naoružanih snaga koje su ih slijedile, a one su ih pogazile i uništile.

verses.text_en: The king’s wrath was converted into compassion; and he wept at the things he had devised.
verses.text_hr: Kraljev se gnjev pretvorio u samilost te je zaplakao zbog svega što je bio smislio.

verses.text_en: For when he heard the cry, and saw them all on the verge of destruction, with tears he angrily threatened his friends, saying,
verses.text_hr: Kad je čuo vapaj i vidio da se svi nalaze pred uništenjem, u suzama je ljutito zaprijetio svojim prijateljima govoreći:

verses.text_en: “You have governed badly, and have exceeded tyrants in cruelty. You have labored to deprive me, your benefactor, at once of my dominion and my life, by secretly devising measures injurious to the kingdom.
verses.text_hr: „Loše ste upravljali i okrutnošću nadmašili tirane. Potajno smišljajući mjere pogubne za kraljevstvo nastojali ste mene, svojega dobročinitelja, istodobno lišiti vlasti i života.

verses.text_en: Who has gathered here, unreasonably removing each from his home, those who, in fidelity to us, had held the fortresses of the country?
verses.text_hr: Tko je nerazumno odveo iz doma i ovdje okupio one koji su nam vjerno čuvali tvrđave zemlje?

verses.text_en: Who has consigned to unmerited punishments those who in good will toward us from the beginning have in all things surpassed all nations, and who often have engaged in the most dangerous undertakings?
verses.text_hr: Tko je nezasluženim kaznama predao ljude koji su nam od početka iskazivali toliku odanost da su u svemu nadmašili sve narode i mnogo se puta upuštali u najopasnije pothvate?

verses.text_en: Loose, loose the unjust bonds! Send them to their homes in peace, begging pardon for what has been done.
verses.text_hr: Oslobodite ih, oslobodite nepravednih okova! Pošaljite ih u miru njihovim domovima i molite ih da oproste ono što im je učinjeno.

verses.text_en: Release the sons of the almighty living God of heaven, who from our ancestors’ times until now has granted a glorious and uninterrupted prosperity to our affairs.”
verses.text_hr: Pustite sinove svemogućega, živog Boga nebeskoga, koji je od vremena naših predaka sve do danas našim poslovima davao slavan i neprekinut napredak.“

verses.text_en: He said these things, and they, released the same moment, having now escaped death, praised God their holy Savior.
verses.text_hr: Tako je rekao, a oni su istoga trenutka oslobođeni. Izbjegavši smrt, hvalili su Boga, svojega svetog Spasitelja.

verses.text_en: The king then departed to the city, and called his financier to himself, and asked him provide a seven days’ quantity of wine and other materials for feasting for the Jews. He decided that they should keep a cheerful festival of deliverance in the very place in which they expected to meet with their destruction.
verses.text_hr: Kralj se zatim vratio u grad, pozvao upravitelja financija i naložio mu da Židovima osigura vina i druge hrane za sedam dana gozbe. Odlučio je da upravo na mjestu na kojem su očekivali propast radosno proslave blagdan izbavljenja.

verses.text_en: Then they who were before despised and near to hades, yes, rather advanced into it, partook of the cup of salvation, instead of a grievous and lamentable death. Full of exultation, they apportioned the place intended for their fall and burial into banqueting booths.
verses.text_hr: Tako su oni koji su prije bili prezreni i blizu Hada — štoviše, već gotovo zakoračili u nj — primili čašu spasenja umjesto teške i žalosne smrti. Ispunjeni klicanjem, prostor namijenjen njihovu padu i grobu podijelili su na sjenice za gozbu.

verses.text_en: Ceasing their miserable strain of woe, they took up the subject of their fatherland, singing in praise to God their wonder-working Savior. All groans and all wailing were laid aside. They formed dances as a sign of peaceful joy.
verses.text_hr: Prestali su sa žalosnim naricanjem i zapjevali o svojoj domovini, hvaleći Boga, čudotvornoga Spasitelja. Odbacili su svaki jecaj i svaki plač te zaplesali u znak mirne radosti.

verses.text_en: So the king also collected a number of guests for the occasion, and returned unceasing thanks with much magnificence for the unexpected deliverance afforded him.
verses.text_hr: I kralj je za tu prigodu okupio mnoštvo gostiju te uz veliku raskoš bez prestanka zahvaljivao za neočekivano izbavljenje koje mu je bilo darovano.

verses.text_en: Those who had marked them out as for death and for carrion, and had registered them with joy, howled aloud, and were clothed with shame, and had the fire of their rage ingloriously put out.
verses.text_hr: Oni koji su ih označili za smrt i strvinu te ih s veseljem popisivali sada su glasno zavijali, zaodjenuti sramotom, dok se plamen njihova bijesa neslavno ugasio.

verses.text_en: But the Jews, as we just said, instituted a dance, and then gave themselves up to feasting, glad thanksgiving, and psalms.
verses.text_hr: Židovi su pak, kao što smo upravo rekli, priredili ples, a potom se predali gozbi, radosnom zahvaljivanju i psalmima.

verses.text_en: They made a public ordinance to commemorate these things for generations to come, as long as they should be sojourners. They thus established these days as days of mirth, not for the purpose of drinking or luxury, but because God had saved them.
verses.text_hr: Donijeli su javnu uredbu da se ti događaji spominju u budućim naraštajima dokle god budu živjeli kao došljaci. Te su dane ustanovili kao dane radosti, ne radi opijanja ili raskoši, nego zato što ih je Bog spasio.

verses.text_en: They requested the king to send them back to their homes.
verses.text_hr: Zamolili su kralja da ih pošalje natrag njihovim domovima.

verses.text_en: They were being enrolled from the twenty-fifth of Pachon to the fourth of Epiphi, a period of forty days. The measures taken for their destruction lasted from the fifth of Epiphi till the seventh, that is, three days.
verses.text_hr: Popisivali su ih od dvadeset petoga dana mjeseca Pahona do četvrtoga dana Epifija, dakle četrdeset dana. Mjere za njihovo uništenje trajale su od petoga do sedmoga dana Epifija, to jest tri dana.

verses.text_en: The Ruler over all during this time manifested his mercy gloriously, and delivered them all together unharmed.
verses.text_hr: Vladar svega tijekom toga je vremena slavno očitovao svoje milosrđe i sve ih zajedno izbavio neozlijeđene.

verses.text_en: They feasted upon the king’s provision up to the fourteenth day, then asked to be sent away.
verses.text_hr: Gostili su se kraljevim zalihama sve do četrnaestoga dana, a zatim zatražili da ih pošalje kući.

verses.text_en: The king commended them, and wrote the following letter, of magnanimous import for them, to the commanders of every city:
verses.text_hr: Kralj ih je pohvalio i zapovjednicima svakoga grada napisao sljedeće pismo, koje je prema njima bilo puno velikodušnosti:
